## Defects
1. **LUMA CTA wrong (regression vs s18).** In every LUMA size the "Shop now" button is a tiny pasted gold strip with the "Free shipping over $50" line baked into the cut, and in s19 the button colour is gold although the source button is cream/white with dark text. s19 report: the analysis reads the panel bbox as including the "Free shipping" line and `bg_color #C9A44A` / white text. Fix at the root: tighten the panel box to the button's own fill region (a deterministic panel-bbox tightener on the source pixels: the connected region of the sampled fill around the CTA text; a separate text line outside that region is not part of the panel), sample fill and text colour from the source button pixels, not from the model's guess when they disagree strongly, and rebuild the button (s18 LUMA had a clean, readable cream "Shop now" button — that is the target look, at a source-relative size). The "Free shipping" line must exist exactly once, as its own text.
2. **LUMA order and overlaps.** `luma-after/ig-feed-45.png`: `$42` overlaps "Free shipping over $50"; `ig-story-916.png`: the LUMA logo sits **under** the headline; `ig-feed-11.png`: `$42` is outside the text group. The source order is logo → headline → $42 → CTA → "Free shipping". s19 says Wonder-planned layouts can override the deterministic order: make the enforce step re-stack the text group (logo, headline, subtext, price, CTA, other texts) in source order with consistent gaps **after** any Wonder plan/patch, so no plan can reorder or overlap them. Overlap between any two text/panel boxes after enforcement → fail.
3. **NORTHBEAN CTA off the column.** `northbean-after/ig-feed-11.png`, `ig-feed-45.png`, `ig-story-916.png`: "Order now" sits to the right, not on the left edge shared by the logo/headline/price above it. The CTA belongs to the text column (same alignment edge) in every family. Make `text_column` include the panel.
4. **NORTHBEAN black shards under the cans.** Jagged black fragments hang under the two standing cans and the lying can in all NORTHBEAN sizes (visible at full size; worse now that the cans are bigger). It is the cut/mask picking up the dark shadow/background under the cans. Clean the product cut: drop thin dark protrusions below the product base (morphological open on the alpha at the base / remove components connected by a thin neck), keep the can edges intact; add a regression test on a synthetic can-with-shard mask, and a deterministic check if feasible.
5. **NORTHBEAN fb-link cans overlap into one blob** and the left half is empty. Multi-product groups keep their source arrangement (relative offsets, no new overlaps between products that didn't overlap in the source) and scale as one group; on landscape the product group takes the side opposite the text with a sensible size.
6. **Subtext colour flip.** `stride-after/ig-feed-11.png`: "The new Aero 2" turned black while the headline and price stay white (s19's `readableTextColor` contrast swap). A swap must be made for the **whole text group** consistently (if one line needs a swap, pick a colour that works for all lines of the group, or keep the source colour and add a subtle backing/shadow), never one line alone. Keep the Hebrew yellow-tagline fix working.
7. **Hebrew badge ghost.** A dark ghost streak under the "חרא חוזר" badge in most Hebrew sizes (`plate_dirty`). Clean the plate region under and around where the source logo/badge was with a proper inpaint (model plate regen of that region, or a patch inpaint that does not streak on gradients/tiles) before stamping the badge.
8. **Over-strict checks.** `hero_too_small` measures the single tallest product cut, so STRIDE story and NORTHBEAN story look right but are `needs_review`. Measure the product group's union box. Don't weaken any other check.

**Do not regress:** STRIDE in all 5 sizes (crisp rebuilt CTA, source reading order, big hero in story), Hebrew "5$ / בלבד" together and legible tagline, no ghost bar under buttons, logo source pixels.
